key.name: map-type
key.description: The type of map to display (street, aerial, etc.)

key.name: max-search-results
key.description: Maximum number of search results from geocode search.

key.name: recent-places-limit
key.summary: Number of recent places to store
key.description: Number of recently visited places to store.

key.name: recent-routes-limit
key.summary: Number of recent routes to store
key.description: Number of recently visited routes to store.

key.name: osm-username-oauth2
key.description: Indicates if the user has signed in to edit OpenStreetMap data.

key.name: transportation-type
key.summary: Last used transportation type for routing

key.name: vector-tile-source-url-pattern
key.description: The URL pattern for the vector tile source to use. Note that the map style relies on certain extensions compared to upstream Planetiler OpenMapTiles Profile

key.name: measurement-system
key.description: How to show measurements. ('system' uses default for system locale, 'metric' always show metric units, 'imperial' always show imperial units).

key.name: show-location-marker
key.description: Whether to show the user location marker (when location is known).

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Which color scheme to render the map in. ('system' follows the system-wide preference, 'light' always shows the map in light colors, 'dark' always shows the map in dark colors).
